scripts.check:moon: moon run tools/prepare-dependencies.mbtx && moon check --target wasm-gc --deny-warn
scripts.build:moon: moon run tools/prepare-dependencies.mbtx && moon build --target wasm-gc --release --deny-warn
scripts.build: bun run build:moon && bun run --filter '@open-document/*' build && cp _build/wasm-gc/release/build/open_document/bridge/bridge.wasm packages/wasm/dist/engine.wasm && bun run build:example
scripts.build:example: bun build examples/web-sdk/app.js --target browser --outdir examples/web-sdk/dist && cp packages/wasm/dist/engine.wasm packages/web/dist/worker.js examples/web-sdk/dist/ && cp -R examples/web-sdk/fonts examples/web-sdk/dist/
scripts.format: moon fmt && moon fmt tools/prepare-dependencies.mbtx && prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .vscode packages examples
scripts.format:check: moon fmt --check && moon fmt --check tools/prepare-dependencies.mbtx && prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .vscode packages examples
scripts.check: bun run check:moon && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.test: test -f test-lab/package.json && cd test-lab && bun run test
